the state of being lower in rank

Islamic tradition based on Muhammad's teachings

ability to survive

a bitter compound found in plants

a short Japanese sword or dagger

a small mountain lake

a dull, resonant sound

a type of tree with small, dark fruit

wicked or criminal behavior

great skill in music or another artistic pursuit

the severity or harmfulness of a disease or poison

a high-ranking political advisor or minister in Muslim countries

playfully quaint or fanciful behavior or humor

an object being worked on or processed

a bitter-tasting plant; a state or source of bitterness or grief

young people, especially those with new ideas or energy

a large freshwater fish of the perch family

Continuously Variable Transmission

the act of ceasing to treat something as illegal or criminal

the action of listing or counting items

the act of bringing a feeling, memory, or image into the mind

the act of bending or the state of being bent

a short musical composition of a dreamy character

a gradual blending of one color hue to another

the use of X-rays or other radiation to view the internal structure of an object

a person who advocates secession
